about: Brodie's telling of the story so far (src/film.js). Changing a line here and pushing has the workflow (.github/workflows/narration.yml) ask the sphere Worker to speak it in Brodie's ElevenLabs voice, once, and keep the clip in assets/film/vo/. Lines that haven't changed are not spoken again. The gone-YEAR lines are the one that follows 'everyone alive in 2027': the film says the year after the one it is played in. The snapshot is of everyone alive in that same year: line 06 says it whole for 2027; for later years it is 06a followed by alive-YEAR. The opening is the same year: line 01 for 2027, earth-YEAR after. Add a year's three lines (earth-YEAR, alive-YEAR, gone-YEAR) before the January it is first needed.

lines.say: A fleet of probes went out, each one looking for a place where life could carry on.
Our land carries Earth's blueprint, and a snapshot of everyone alive in twenty twenty-seven.
A few centuries out, a glitch in the wormhole opened black holes inside our ship.
The wormhole links the ships of the fleet. Things come through it.
One ship carries the Shred Hole: a fabricator that lost its Earth blueprint in an accident.
Before it went dark, another ship found something. It called it World Builder.
So it's up to us to find our way again.
Until then, we garden. We build the wall. And whatever else suits our fancy, brody.
They threw us off course. They come and go as they wish.
